titles.twopost_1loop_l: Two Posts One Loop, long span

connector._note: from fit_ladder.stl / fit_ladder_1p5.stl and tube_*.stl; plug_od is fit-ladder step 1.5 (steps 1/2/3 = 25.7/25.8/25.9). plug_slot_r rounds the two top corners of the split-ring gap, where each ring end meets the plug top (Aaron 2026-11-23: every plug has the gap and rounded top corners, never without)

spans._note: post-to-post spacing for the two planned versions of each two-post piece; raw caliper/tape readings. long centre = gap + post_od (29.6, the design value, not measured on the set); long gap remeasured by Aaron 2026-11-15 12:35 MST as 156.2 (was 154.9, centre 184.5). short centre not derived (which inner walls is unconfirmed). real plugs measure 25.4

short.walls: socket inner wall to socket inner wall

long.walls: gap between the outsides of the two sockets (nearest sides)

refit._note: imported Marbleworks pieces rebuilt for the measured set by src/refit.py. post values are in source coordinates: xy axis, levels (bottom, top, in whole tube pitches), slot (direction of the source plug slot, deg), slot_depth (mm the slot runs below the plug base where it ends in the wall; it is then closed with the post's own wall from slot_fill.turn deg away. 0 where the slot opens into a window: the new shoulder is left open over it instead, open_half deg either side, so the slot runs to the top as in the source). options that remove the need for supports: gable [direction deg, half width deg, turn deg, drop mm, notch mm] makes a window top a 45 deg point 1 mm under the shoulder: wall taken from turn deg away is added over the two 45 deg lines for drop mm below the peak, and the wall under them is cut for notch mm; arch [direction deg, rise mm, half width mm, depth mm] cuts the shallow shoulders of a round window top that runs into the open slot back to 45 deg lines meeting rise mm above the post body top; ceiling puts a 45 deg cone ceiling over a socket nothing passes through, keeping at least ceiling.floor mm of the floor above it; keel adds a 45 deg keel under the track between the posts

cascade._note: src/cascade.py. span is the long centre 185.8 less 2 mm: Aaron found the printed clicky_5_half_l about 2 mm too long (2026-11-17). levels: the emit post bottom sits this many tube pitches up. sill_e is above the emit post bottom, sill_r above the bed. drop is floor to floor at each hole. gap is the clearance from the ramp ends to the towers under and over the posts. floor_tilt is the slope of the emit floor over the socket cone

epi_keel._note: src/epi_keel.py, 45 deg keel under the whole Epitrochoid track (Aaron 2026-11-25: like the clicky ramp, so the tall trees can go; keep the bed trees up to about layer 570 for one turn of support against shaking). base is the refit without trees, supports the designed-in trees. grid, reach, jump in mm; ndir rays per point; clear is the room kept over the layer below (marble 14.5 + 2); keel bottoms under bed_snap go to the bed; keep_top is the tallest bed tree kept; keep_struts keeps the short trees between turns

epi_top._note: src/epi_top.py, top post of the Epitrochoid refit with designed-in supports (Aaron 2026-11-25). mesh coordinates, post axis at x = y = 0. moves the plug gap from the back (old_gap, deg) to the exit window (exit, deg): radial sides at +-slot_half deg, the window side faces, so the window runs to the top with no overhang (Aaron: no overhang); top corners rounded to slot_r along the ring at r_ref (16 was too much, 2026-11-25); the gap runs down from the plug top to slot_zb, below the sleeve band over the window. the midair cone under the landing floor is replaced by a 45 deg underside that starts on the exit-side wall at ramp_z0 and rises toward the back wall. the plug keeps its Nov 8 size (plug_ro, plug_ri)

fin._note: web filling the slit between the right-hand track wall and the window edge (Aaron 2026-11-25). box is w0, w1, v0, v1 in exit coordinates (w toward the exit, v to its left) and picks the wall sections; side_deg is the far edge of the post patch it grows from; flat at ztop from the post, then 45 deg down along the wall
